dialogues.title: An ethics committee
dialogues.scene: 两位研究人员讨论数据隐私

lines.en: My reservation about the proposal isn't the research question itself, which is perfectly legitimate, but the consent process.
lines.zh: 我对这个提案的保留意见不在研究问题本身——它完全正当——而在知情同意流程。

lines.en: You mean the fact that participants agree to their data being reused for 'related studies'?
lines.zh: 你是说参与者同意其数据被用于“相关研究”这一点？

lines.en: Precisely. 'Related' is doing an awful lot of work in that sentence. It's elastic enough to cover almost anything.
lines.zh: 正是。“相关”这个词在那句话里承担了太多含义，弹性大到几乎可以涵盖任何事情。

lines.en: I take the point, but if we insist on fresh consent for every secondary use, a great deal of valuable research simply won't get done.
lines.zh: 我明白你的意思，但如果每次二次使用都要求重新征得同意，大量有价值的研究就根本做不成。

lines.en: I'm not suggesting anything so absolutist. A tiered model — where people can opt into broad, narrow or no reuse — would strike a better balance.
lines.zh: 我并不是主张那么绝对。分级模式——让人们选择广泛复用、有限复用或不复用——能取得更好的平衡。

lines.en: That's not unreasonable, though I suspect most people tick whichever box requires the least reading.
lines.zh: 这并非不合理，不过我怀疑大多数人会勾选那个需要读得最少的选项。

lines.en: Which is an argument for writing the form more clearly, not for dispensing with the choice altogether.
lines.zh: 这恰恰说明应该把表格写得更清楚，而不是干脆取消选择。

lines.en: Touché. Shall we recommend approval, conditional on a revised consent form?
lines.zh: 说得好。那我们建议有条件批准，前提是修订知情同意书？

lines.en: I'd be comfortable with that, provided we see the revised wording before it goes out.
lines.zh: 我可以接受，前提是修订后的措辞在发出前要给我们过目。

lines.en: I'll confess, I found the narrator insufferable. Three hundred pages of self-pity dressed up as introspection.
lines.zh: 我得承认，我觉得叙述者令人难以忍受。三百页的自怜，伪装成内省。

lines.en: But surely that's the point? The novel is an indictment of precisely that kind of self-absorption.
lines.zh: 可这不正是重点吗？这部小说控诉的恰恰就是那种自我沉溺。

lines.en: If it is, it's awfully subtle about it. I never once felt the author was holding him at arm's length.
lines.zh: 如果是这样，那它也太含蓄了。我一次都没觉得作者跟他保持了距离。

lines.en: What about the scene with his daughter at the station? Everything he says is contradicted by what we see her do.
lines.zh: 那车站和他女儿的那场戏呢？他说的每一句话都被我们看到的她的行为所否定。

lines.en: Hmm. I'd read that as a flaw in the writing rather than a deliberate irony.
lines.zh: 嗯。我把那理解为写作上的缺陷，而不是刻意的反讽。

lines.en: That's the trouble with unreliable narrators — the more skilfully they're done, the easier they are to mistake for authorial endorsement.
lines.zh: 这就是不可靠叙述者的麻烦——写得越巧妙，越容易被误认为是作者的认同。

lines.en: Perhaps. I may need to reread it with that in mind, though I'm not sure I can face him a second time.
lines.zh: 也许吧。我可能得带着这个思路重读一遍，虽然我不确定能否再忍受他一次。

lines.en: Skip to the final chapter. If that doesn't change your mind, nothing will.
lines.zh: 直接跳到最后一章。如果那都改变不了你的看法，那就没什么能改变了。

dialogues.title: Crisis communications
dialogues.scene: 公司高管讨论数据泄露的对外声明

lines.en: Legal would prefer we say as little as possible until the investigation's concluded.
lines.zh: 法务希望在调查结束前我们尽量少说。

lines.en: I understand their instinct, but silence will be read as evasiveness. The story's already out there.
lines.zh: 我理解他们的本能反应，但沉默会被解读为回避。消息已经传开了。

lines.en: So what are you proposing — that we speculate about the cause before we know it?
lines.zh: 那你的提议是什么——在我们弄清原因之前就去猜测？

lines.en: Not at all. We acknowledge what's happened, set out what we know and don't know, and commit to a timetable for updates.
lines.zh: 完全不是。我们承认发生的事，说明已知和未知的情况，并承诺更新信息的时间表。

lines.en: And crucially, we tell customers exactly what steps they should take now to protect themselves.
lines.zh: 而且关键是，要明确告诉客户他们现在应采取哪些措施保护自己。

lines.en: An apology, too?
lines.zh: 还要道歉吗？

lines.en: A genuine one, yes — not the 'we regret any inconvenience' variety. People can smell a non-apology a mile off.
lines.zh: 要，而且是真诚的——不是“对造成的任何不便深表遗憾”那种。人们老远就能闻出敷衍的道歉。

lines.en: Legal will balk at anything resembling an admission of liability.
lines.zh: 法务会反对任何类似承认责任的表述。

lines.en: Then let's get them in the room. There's a way to take responsibility for the response without prejudging the cause.
lines.zh: 那就请他们一起来谈。我们可以对应对措施负责，而不预先认定原因。

dialogues.title: Urban planning debate
dialogues.scene: 市议会听证会上的交锋

lines.en: The new zoning plan would allow mid-rise apartments along the tram corridor, which is the only realistic way to ease the housing shortage.
lines.zh: 新的分区规划将允许在电车沿线建设中层公寓，这是缓解住房短缺唯一现实的办法。

lines.en: Nobody here disputes that we need more housing. What we object to is the absence of any commitment to affordability.
lines.zh: 这里没人质疑我们需要更多住房。我们反对的是规划中没有任何关于可负担性的承诺。

lines.en: Increasing supply will, over time, put downward pressure on rents across the city.
lines.zh: 增加供应终将对全市租金形成下行压力。

lines.en: 'Over time' is cold comfort to families being priced out this year. And the evidence on filtering is far from conclusive.
lines.zh: “终将”对今年就被高房价挤走的家庭来说是聊胜于无。而且关于“过滤效应”的证据远非定论。

lines.en: Mandating a high proportion of affordable units risks making schemes unviable, in which case nothing gets built at all.
lines.zh: 强制规定高比例的保障性住房，可能让项目无利可图，那样就什么都建不起来了。

lines.en: Then set the threshold where viability studies say it's sustainable. Fifteen percent is hardly a radical demand.
lines.zh: 那就把门槛设在可行性研究认为可持续的水平。百分之十五算不上什么激进要求。

lines.en: I'm willing to take that figure back to the planning committee, on the understanding that it's subject to independent review.
lines.zh: 我愿意把这个数字带回规划委员会，但前提是它要经过独立评估。

lines.en: That's all we've been asking for.
lines.zh: 这正是我们一直以来的要求。

dialogues.title: Reflecting on a career
dialogues.scene: 访谈一位即将退休的外科医生

lines.en: After forty years in the operating theatre, what's changed most?
lines.zh: 在手术室工作了四十年，变化最大的是什么？

lines.en: Technically, almost everything. Procedures that once required a week in hospital are now done as day cases.
lines.zh: 技术上几乎全变了。过去需要住院一周的手术，现在当天就能出院。

lines.en: But the change I value most is cultural. When I started, questioning a senior surgeon was practically unthinkable.
lines.zh: 但我最看重的是文化上的变化。我刚入行时，质疑资深外科医生几乎是不可想象的。

lines.en: And now?
lines.zh: 那现在呢？

lines.en: Now the most junior nurse is expected to speak up if something looks wrong — and rightly so. Checklists have saved more lives than any instrument I've used.
lines.zh: 现在，即使是资历最浅的护士，发现问题也应该说出来——这完全正确。检查清单挽救的生命比我用过的任何器械都多。

lines.en: Is there anything you'd have done differently?
lines.zh: 有什么事你希望当初换种方式做吗？

lines.en: I'd have been less reluctant to admit uncertainty. Patients don't need a surgeon who pretends to be infallible; they need one who's honest about the odds.
lines.zh: 我会更坦然地承认不确定性。病人需要的不是假装万无一失的外科医生，而是对风险坦诚相告的医生。

lines.en: That's a striking admission.
lines.zh: 这样的坦白令人印象深刻。

lines.en: It took me the better part of a career to learn it.
lines.zh: 我花了大半个职业生涯才学会这一点。

sentences.en: Over the past decade or so, several fields — most notably psychology — have been grappling with what has come to be known as the replication crisis.
sentences.zh: 大约在过去十年里，若干学科——最突出的是心理学——一直在应对所谓的“可重复性危机”。

sentences.en: Large-scale efforts to repeat landmark studies found that a substantial proportion of results could not be reproduced.
sentences.zh: 大规模重复经典研究的尝试发现，相当一部分结果无法被复现。

sentences.en: The causes are as much institutional as individual: journals favoured striking, positive findings, and careers depended on publishing them.
sentences.zh: 其原因既在个人也在制度：期刊偏爱引人注目的阳性结果，而学术生涯又依赖于发表这些结果。

sentences.en: Small samples and flexible analysis made it all too easy to find patterns that were, in fact, statistical noise.
sentences.zh: 小样本和灵活的分析方法，使人们太容易发现那些实际上只是统计噪声的规律。

sentences.en: The response has included pre-registration, in which researchers publicly commit to their hypotheses and methods before collecting data.
sentences.zh: 应对措施包括“预注册”，即研究人员在收集数据之前公开承诺其假设和方法。

sentences.en: Some argue that the crisis, painful as it has been, is ultimately a sign of science correcting itself.
sentences.zh: 有人认为，这场危机尽管痛苦，但归根结底是科学自我纠正的标志。

questions.q: What did large-scale replication efforts find?
questions.qZh: 大规模重复研究发现了什么？
options: Many results could not be reproduced

questions.qZh: 提到了哪个制度性因素？

options: Committing to hypotheses and methods before collecting data

sentences.en: Every translator faces a tension that can never be fully resolved: fidelity to the words versus fidelity to the effect.
sentences.zh: 每位译者都面临一种永远无法彻底化解的张力：忠实于字句，还是忠实于效果。

sentences.en: A pun, a rhyme or a culturally loaded idiom may have no equivalent at all, forcing a choice between accuracy and naturalness.
sentences.zh: 一个双关语、一处押韵或一个富含文化内涵的习语，可能根本没有对应表达，迫使译者在准确与自然之间取舍。

sentences.en: Some translators deliberately preserve a degree of foreignness, so that readers remain aware they are encountering another culture.
sentences.zh: 有些译者刻意保留一定的异质感，让读者意识到自己在接触另一种文化。

sentences.en: Others aim for a text that reads as though it had been written in the target language from the outset.
sentences.zh: 另一些译者则力求译文读起来仿佛一开始就是用目标语言写成的。

sentences.en: Neither approach is inherently superior; each makes some things visible at the expense of others.
sentences.zh: 两种方法本身并无高下之分；每一种都在凸显某些东西的同时牺牲了另一些。

questions.q: What tension does every translator face?
questions.qZh: 每位译者都面临什么张力？
options: Fidelity to words versus fidelity to effect

questions.qZh: 译者为何会保留“异质感”？
options: So readers stay aware of the other culture

sentences.en: Half a century ago, the economist Herbert Simon observed that a wealth of information creates a poverty of attention.
sentences.zh: 半个世纪前，经济学家赫伯特·西蒙指出，信息的丰富会导致注意力的匮乏。

sentences.en: His remark has proved strikingly prescient.
sentences.zh: 他的这番话被证明极具先见之明。

sentences.en: Many of the most valuable companies in the world now compete not for our money directly, but for our time and focus.
sentences.zh: 如今，世界上许多最有价值的公司争夺的并不是我们的钱本身，而是我们的时间和注意力。

sentences.en: Their products are refined through relentless testing to maximise engagement, a metric that does not necessarily align with users' wellbeing.
sentences.zh: 它们的产品经过不断测试来最大化“参与度”，而这一指标未必与用户的福祉一致。

sentences.en: Critics contend that this asymmetry — vast engineering resources on one side, an individual's willpower on the other — makes self-discipline an inadequate response.
sentences.zh: 批评者认为，这种不对称——一边是庞大的工程资源，一边是个人的意志力——使得自律成为一种不充分的应对方式。

sentences.en: Instead, they call for design standards and regulation, much as we regulate other products that can cause harm.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们呼吁制定设计标准和监管，就像我们监管其他可能造成危害的产品那样。

questions.qZh: 赫伯特·西蒙观察到了什么？
options: Information creates a poverty of attention

questions.q: What does 'engagement' not necessarily align with?

sentences.en: We tend to imagine memory as a kind of recording, faithfully stored and replayed on demand.
sentences.zh: 我们往往把记忆想象成一种录像，被忠实保存，随时回放。

sentences.en: Decades of research suggest that it is far more like reconstruction, assembled afresh each time we recall an event.
sentences.zh: 数十年的研究表明，它更像是一种重建，每次回忆一件事时都会重新拼凑。

sentences.en: In classic experiments, the wording of a single question — whether cars 'smashed' or 'hit' each other — altered what witnesses later claimed to have seen.
sentences.zh: 在经典实验中，仅仅一个问题的措辞——汽车是“猛撞”还是“碰撞”——就改变了证人后来声称看到的内容。

sentences.en: Some participants even came to vividly 'remember' childhood events that had never taken place.
sentences.zh: 一些参与者甚至开始清晰地“记得”从未发生过的童年事件。

sentences.en: Such findings have had profound implications for the legal system, where eyewitness testimony was long regarded as among the most compelling forms of evidence.
sentences.zh: 这些发现对司法系统产生了深远影响，因为目击证词长期以来被视为最有力的证据形式之一。

questions.q: According to research, memory is more like…
What changed witnesses' memories in the experiments?
questions.qZh: 实验中是什么改变了证人的记忆？

questions.q: Which field has been profoundly affected?
questions.qZh: 哪个领域受到了深远影响？

news.title: Honeybee dominance raises questions over urban beekeeping boom
news.titleZh: 蜜蜂的统治地位引发对城市养蜂热的质疑

sentences.en: For years, keeping honeybees has been promoted as an easy way for city dwellers to 'save the bees'.
sentences.zh: 多年来，养蜜蜂一直被宣传为城市居民“拯救蜜蜂”的简单方式。

sentences.en: A new study published in Ecological Entomology suggests the picture is considerably more complicated.
sentences.zh: 一项发表于《生态昆虫学》的新研究表明，情况要复杂得多。

sentences.en: Over two years, researchers observed pollinators at five sites near Cambridge, each within 300 metres of known honeybee colonies.
sentences.zh: 研究人员在两年间观察了剑桥附近五个地点的传粉昆虫，每个地点都位于已知蜂群300米范围内。

sentences.en: Honeybees not only prevailed in most encounters but initiated the bulk of aggressive interactions, frequently driving competitors off bramble and ivy flowers.
sentences.zh: 蜜蜂不仅在大多数遭遇中占上风，还发起了大部分攻击性互动，经常把竞争者赶离黑莓和常春藤花。

sentences.en: Only the ivy bee, a solitary species that arrived in Britain in 2001, routinely held its ground.
sentences.zh: 只有常春藤蜂——一种2001年才来到英国的独居蜂——经常能坚守阵地。

sentences.en: Tellingly, competition intensified on hotter days, plausibly because heat stress curtails nectar production and leaves less to go around.
sentences.zh: 耐人寻味的是，竞争在更热的日子里加剧，这可能是因为高温胁迫抑制了花蜜分泌，使可分配的资源更少。

sentences.en: With registered beekeepers in the UK having more than doubled since 2010, the authors argue that hive density, particularly in cities, warrants active management.
sentences.zh: 由于英国注册养蜂人数自2010年以来增加了一倍多，作者认为蜂箱密度——尤其是在城市——需要积极管理。

sentences.en: They are careful to stress, however, that their aim is coexistence rather than discouraging beekeeping altogether.
sentences.zh: 不过他们谨慎地强调，其目标是共存，而非全然劝阻养蜂。

news.title: The silent toll of Europe's hottest summers

sentences.en: Some 50,000 people are estimated to have died as a result of this summer's European heatwaves, according to a study released this week.
sentences.zh: 根据本周发布的一项研究，估计约有5万人死于今夏欧洲热浪。

sentences.en: Of those, roughly two-thirds are attributed to the additional warming caused by human activity.
sentences.zh: 其中约三分之二被归因于人类活动造成的额外升温。

sentences.en: Because the analysis was confined to 854 urban areas, the researchers concede that the overall toll is almost certainly an underestimate.
sentences.zh: 由于分析仅限于854个城市地区，研究人员承认总死亡人数几乎肯定被低估了。

sentences.en: Attribution studies of this kind, once regarded as speculative, have become an increasingly robust tool for quantifying the human cost of a warming climate.
sentences.zh: 这类归因研究曾被视为推测性的，如今已日益成为量化气候变暖人员代价的可靠工具。

sentences.en: Heat is a peculiarly insidious hazard: it leaves no rubble, and its victims — disproportionately elderly and isolated — rarely make headlines.
sentences.zh: 高温是一种格外隐蔽的危害：它不留下废墟，其受害者——以老年人和独居者居多——也很少登上新闻头条。

sentences.en: Advocates argue that until heatwaves are treated with the same urgency as floods or wildfires, preventable deaths will continue to mount.
sentences.zh: 倡导者认为，在热浪得到与洪水或山火同等的重视之前，可避免的死亡将继续增加。

news.title: Do city birds read gender? A puzzling flight response
news.titleZh: 城市鸟类能识别性别？一种令人费解的逃飞反应

sentences.en: Urban birds across Europe appear to be warier of women than of men, according to research published in People and Nature.
sentences.zh: 根据发表在《人与自然》上的研究，欧洲各地的城市鸟类似乎对女性比对男性更警惕。

sentences.en: The study measured flight initiation distance — how close a person can approach before a bird takes off — across 2,701 trials.
sentences.zh: 该研究在2701次试验中测量了“惊飞距离”——即人能接近到多近鸟才会起飞。

sentences.en: Observers in Czechia, France, Germany, Poland and Spain, matched for height and dressed identically, walked directly towards 37 species.
sentences.zh: 在捷克、法国、德国、波兰和西班牙，身高相当、衣着相同的观察者径直走向37种鸟。

sentences.en: On average, men were able to get roughly a metre closer than women before the birds fled.
sentences.zh: 平均而言，男性能比女性多靠近大约一米，鸟才逃走。

sentences.en: The authors float several hypotheses, including differences in gait, body shape or scent, but acknowledge that all of them remain speculative.
sentences.zh: 作者提出了几种假设，包括步态、体型或气味的差异，但承认这些都仍是推测。

sentences.en: The finding has methodological implications too: studies of animal behaviour may need to account for the sex of the human observer.
sentences.zh: 这一发现在方法论上也有意义：动物行为研究可能需要考虑人类观察者的性别。
